function.name: read_inbox
function.description: Scans the local 'NOVA_Inbox' folder on the user's desktop. It can either list the files currently in the inbox, or read the text content of a specific file inside it.

action.description: What to do with the inbox. Either 'list_files' or 'read_file'.

filename.description: If action is 'read_file', provide the exact name of the file to read.
